opennyai_summary.decision:
2. This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 o f the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.251/2022 registered at Police Station Gandhwani, District Dhar (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 366(A), 376, 376(2)(N),
376(2) (K), 376(2)(1), 376(3) and 344 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 3/4, 5L/6 of the POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 19/07/2022.
3. After arguing for some time, learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present bail application.
4. Accordingly, the second bail application preferred under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. is dismissed as withdrawn.
